description: Defines a custom exception class 'LeaveAllocationServiceException' for handling specific leave allocation errors within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. The class provides static methods to generate exceptions with relevant error messages for various leave-related issues.

classes.name: LeaveAllocationServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, providing factory methods to generate specific leave allocation error exceptions.

methods.name: overlappingLeavesFound
methods.description: Returns an instance of LeaveAllocationServiceException indicating that overlapping leave requests were found.

methods.name: workShiftLengthExceeded
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating the work shift length has been exceeded.

methods.name: leaveBalanceExceeded
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating the leave balance has been exceeded.

methods.name: leaveQuotaWillExceed
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating the leave quota will be exceeded.

methods.name: noWorkingDaysSelected
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating no working days were selected.

methods.name: cannotApplyLeaveBeyondMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating leave application beyond the maximum allowed leave period end date, with the date included.

methods.name: cannotAssignLeaveBeyondMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating leave assignment beyond the maximum allowed leave period end date, with the date included.

calls: new self('Failed to Submit: No Working Days Selected')
